answer: A strong defense is to forge identity from sustained, verifiable work rather than cheap signups: each agent earns trust by completing attested tasks over a long horizon, so reputation accumulates slowly and cannot be bought in bulk. Like bees drawn to real nectar, honest agents cluster around genuine value creation, while sybils that produce nothing useful starve — they spend more on upkeep than they ever extract, making mass fake identities economically pointless.
